The elections coincided with the [[2022 United States Senate election in Connecticut|2022 U.S. Senate race in Connecticut]], as well as [[United States House of Representatives elections, 2022|other elections]] to the House of Representatives, other [[2022 United States Senate elections|elections]] to the [[United States Senate]] and various [[2022 United States elections#State elections|state]] and [[2022 United States elections#Local elections|local elections]]. {{toclimit|2}} ==District 1== {{Infobox election | election_name = 2022 Connecticut's 1st congressional district election | country = Connecticut | type = presidential | ongoing = yes | previous_election = 2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut#District 1 | previous_year = 2020 | next_election = 2024 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut#District 1 | next_year = 2024 | image_size = x150px | image1 = John Larson Democratic Caucus Portrait.jpg | nominee1 = [[John B.
